_comment: Centralised tap registry. A relative repo_path is resolved against the workspace root (the folder that contains parallelism-benchmark/); every other path is relative to the tap repository. Existing tap files are only ever READ.

isolation_findings: tap_jira.context.Context is a class-level singleton (config, state, catalog, client): in-process threading would share it, so it was rejected.
One Client owns a single requests.Session and a request-spacing timer; every worker process builds its own.

Child streams are written by their parent (projects -> versions, components; issues -> issue_comments, changelogs, issue_transitions; groups -> group_users) and tap_jira.streams.validate_dependencies() requires the parent to be selected, so each family is one work unit.
HTTP 429 is mapped to JiraRateLimitError (tap_jira/http.py ERROR_CODE_EXCEPTION_MAPPING); connection/5xx errors are retried with backoff (max_tries=6).
tap-jira.notes: Child streams are emitted by their parent stream, so each parent family is one work unit.

isolation_findings: tap_oracle_fusion.sync.sync() is one loop over catalog.get_selected_streams() sharing a single OracleClient (requests.Session), one BICCExtractClient and one state dict; all records go to one stdout.

Every selected stream is a BICC datastore extract (path biacm/rest/meta/datastores/...): an ESS job is created/reused per datastore, polled, and the extract file is downloaded before rows are yielded, so a record limit shortens only the post-download processing, not the server-side extraction.
BICC jobs are reused on the server between runs; the benchmark therefore sets bicc_force_full_sync=true in a temporary copy of the config so each run performs a full extract.
tap-oracle-fusion.notes: The existing catalog is the source of truth: its selected/unselected flags are preserved and only streams selected there are benchmarked; excluded streams are reported but never run.

isolation_findings: tap_sap_success_factors.sync.sync() is one loop over catalog.get_selected_streams() sharing a single SAPSuccessFactorsClient (session + OAuth token) and one state dict.
Child streams (parent-tap-stream-id metadata) are synced through their parent and an unselected parent is synced just to reach a selected child, so each parent family is one work unit.
OAuth is performed per process (token request per worker process); the 429 handler waits for Retry-After (backoff.runtime, max_tries=5).
tap-sap-success-factors.notes: Each stream needs ~2-3s of process start + OAuth, so unlimited stream families are batched 10 per process (streams_per_task=10); a batch runs its streams one after another, so N workers = at most N streams in flight. Streams that have a record limit always get their own process.

tap-activecampaign.rate_limit_info: 5 requests/second per account (ActiveCampaign API docs, referenced in tap_activecampaign/client.py; the tap throttles itself to 5 req/s per process)
isolation_findings: tap_activecampaign.sync.sync() is one loop over catalog.get_selected_streams() sharing one ActiveCampaign client (requests.Session) and one state dict.
SUB_STREAMS maps ecommerce_orders -> ecommerce_order_products, which the parent emits, so they form one work unit.

email_activities is listed as a child of contacts in the catalog but is NOT emitted by it: sync.py runs it separately via EmailActivities.sync_for_all_contacts(), so it is scheduled as an independent unit (registry independent_streams).

client.request() is wrapped in @utils.ratelimit(5, 1): a per-process limiter of 5 calls/second. Worker processes do not share it, so N workers can send up to 5N requests/second against one account - the main parallelism risk, measured through 429/throttle counters.
Requests are retried with backoff (max_tries=5, factor=2) for 5xx, 429 and OSError.
tap-activecampaign.notes: 60 selected streams; email_activities requests every contact individually.

tap-salesforce.skip_reason: Configuration is known to be invalid (existing catalog is empty: discovery never succeeded). To enable: fix tmp/configs/config.json, set enabled=true, known_invalid_config=false and catalog_strategy=discover_if_missing.
